abstract: Background/Objectives: Malignant gastric outlet obstruction (GOO) is a clinically relevant complication of advanced pancreatic cancer. Conventional gastroenterostomy may be limited by delayed gastric emptying (DGE) and delayed recovery of oral intake. Gastric partitioning has been proposed to improve postoperative gastric emptying. This study compared early postoperative and functional outcomes after conventional gastroenterostomy (GEA) and gastroenterostomy with gastric partitioning (GEAP) in patients with metastatic pancreatic cancer and locally advanced primary tumors causing GOO. Methods: This single-center retrospective comparative cohort included consecutive patients undergoing surgical palliation between January 2021 and June 2026. Outcomes included operative time, time to resumption of oral intake, Gastric Outlet Obstruction Scoring System (GOOSS) at discharge, postoperative length of stay, DGE, 30-day complications, and mortality. Results: Twenty patients were included, with 10 in each group. Median operative time was 127.5 min (IQR 95-140) after GEA and 80 min (IQR 67.75-93.75) after GEAP (p = 0.052). All patients resumed oral intake, with a median time of 4.5 days (IQR 2.25-9.25) after GEA versus 1.5 days (IQR 0.25-3) after GEAP (p = 0.063). Among patients discharged alive (GEA, N = 7; GEAP, N = 10), median postoperative length of stay was 11 days (IQR 9.5-11.5) versus 8 days (IQR 6.25-11.5) (p = 0.364), while median discharge GOOSS was 3 (IQR 2-3) in both groups (p = 1.000). DGE occurred in 40% after GEA and 10% after GEAP (OR 0.17, 95% CI 0.01-1.88; p = 0.303), with grade C DGE observed only after GEA. Thirty-day postoperative complications occurred in 90% versus 60% (p = 0.303), and mortality was 30% versus 10% (p = 0.582). Conclusions: GEAP showed favorable early postoperative outcomes, particularly regarding resumption of oral intake and DGE. However, given the small sample size, retrospective design, and absence of statistically significant differences, these findings remain preliminary and hypothesis-generating and do not establish superiority over conventional GEA. Larger prospective studies are warranted.
key_points_ko: 총 20명의 환자가 포함되었으며 GEA 그룹과 GEAP 그룹에 각각 10명씩 배정되었습니다.
중앙값 기준 경구 식이 재개 시간은 GEA 4.5일, GEAP 1.5일이었습니다.
위배출 지연(DGE)은 GEA 그룹의 40%, GEAP 그룹의 10명 중 10%(초록에 명시되지 않음, 비율상 10%)에서 발생했습니다.
30일 이내 수술 후 합병증은 GEA 그룹 90%, GEAP 그룹 60%에서 발생했습니다.
summary_ko: 이 연구는 전이성 췌장암 환자의 악성 위출구 폐쇄(GOO)에서 위 분할을 동반한 위공장문합술(GEAP)과 일반 위공장문합술(GEA)의 수술 후 초기 결과 및 기능을 비교했습니다. 총 20명의 환자(각 그룹당 10명)를 대상으로 분석을 진행했습니다. 연구 결과, GEAP 그룹은 일반 GEA 그룹에 비해 경구 식이 재개까지 걸리는 시간 단축 및 수술 후 위배출 지연(DGE) 감소 경향을 보였습니다. 그러나 표본 크기가 작고 통계적 유의성이 부족하여 추가적인 대규모 전향적 연구가 필요합니다.
title: Gastroenterostomy With or Without Gastric Partitioning for Malignant Gastric Outlet Obstruction in Metastatic Pancreatic Cancer with Locally Advanced Primary Tumors: A Single-Center Comparative Case Series with Video Technique
title_ko: 전이성 췌장암의 악성 위출구 폐쇄에서 위 분할을 동반한 위공장문합술과 일반 위공장문합술의 비교: 단일 기관 후향적 증례 대조 연구
